scripts.build: node scripts/generate-version.mjs && node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && tsc -b && node scripts/prepare-packages.mjs
scripts.build:conformance-apps: loutre build fixtures/http-crud/src/app.ts --out-dir dist/conformance/http-crud && loutre build fixtures/streaming/src/http-app.ts --out-dir dist/conformance/streaming-http && loutre build fixtures/streaming/src/message-port-app.ts --out-dir dist/conformance/streaming-message-port
scripts.build:conformance-apps:bun: bun packages/cli/bin/loutre.js build fixtures/http-crud/src/app.ts --out-dir dist/conformance/http-crud && bun packages/cli/bin/loutre.js build fixtures/streaming/src/http-app.ts --out-dir dist/conformance/streaming-http && bun packages/cli/bin/loutre.js build fixtures/streaming/src/message-port-app.ts --out-dir dist/conformance/streaming-message-port
scripts.build:conformance-apps:deno: deno run -A packages/cli/bin/loutre.js build fixtures/http-crud/src/app.ts --out-dir dist/conformance/http-crud && deno run -A packages/cli/bin/loutre.js build fixtures/streaming/src/http-app.ts --out-dir dist/conformance/streaming-http && deno run -A packages/cli/bin/loutre.js build fixtures/streaming/src/message-port-app.ts --out-dir dist/conformance/streaming-message-port
scripts.test:deno: deno task build:conformance-apps:deno && deno run -A --sloppy-imports conformance/deno.ts
scripts.test:bun: bun run build:conformance-apps:bun && bun run conformance/bun.ts
scripts.test:node: node -e "const major = Number(process.versions.node.split('.')[0]); if (major < 22) process.exit(1); console.log('Node.js ' + process.versions.node + ' conformance: passed')" && vitest run tests/http-crud.e2e.test.ts tests/http-stream.fixture.test.ts tests/runtime-conformance.test.ts
scripts.test:conformance: npm run test:node && npm run test:deno && npm run test:bun && npm run test:cloudflare-workers && npm run test:electron && npm run test:aws-lambda
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run check && npm run test:types && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:conformance
scripts.release:check: npm run build && node scripts/verify-release-version.mjs && node scripts/verify-packages.mjs
scripts.release:version: changeset version && node scripts/sync-release-version.mjs && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund && npm run release:check
